package main

import (
 "bufio"
 "encoding/json"
 "fmt"
 "os"
 "regexp"
 "runtime"
 "runtime/pprof"
 "time"
 lint "zabaplint"
)
type input struct{Files []lint.File;Config string}
func main(){
 var data input;raw,err:=os.ReadFile(os.Args[1]);if err!=nil{panic(err)};if err=json.Unmarshal(raw,&data);err!=nil{panic(err)}
 var c lint.Checker;c.Prime(data.Files,nil,data.Config)
 files,found:=c.Files("CLAS","ZCL_OSD_ADT_URI");if !found{panic("missing URI")}
 var original lint.File;for _,f:=range files{if regexp.MustCompile(`zcl_osd_adt_uri.clas.abap$`).MatchString(f.Filename){original=f}}
 pattern:=regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)(\bMETHOD\s+[^.]+\.)`);loc:=pattern.FindStringIndex(original.Raw);if loc==nil{panic("no method")};broken:=original.Raw[:loc[1]]+"\n    step3_undefined = 1."+original.Raw[loc[1]:]
 if broken==original.Raw{panic("no edit")}
 c.CheckObject("CLAS","ZCL_OSD_ADT_URI")
 reader:=bufio.NewScanner(os.Stdin);encoder:=json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout);fmt.Println(`{"Ready":true}`)
 var profile *os.File
 for reader.Scan(){
  command:=reader.Text()
  if command=="profile"{profile,err=os.Create(os.Args[2]);if err!=nil{panic(err)};if err=pprof.StartCPUProfile(profile);err!=nil{panic(err)};fmt.Println(`{"Profiling":true}`);continue}
  if command=="stop"{pprof.StopCPUProfile();profile.Close();fmt.Println(`{"Profiling":false}`);continue}
  c.CheckObject("CLAS","ZCL_OSD_ADT_URI")
  before:=c.Stats();var mem0,mem1 runtime.MemStats;runtime.ReadMemStats(&mem0)
  start:=time.Now();parts:=[]float64{};issues:=0
  switch command{
  case "broken":c.Update(original.Filename,&broken);out,_:=c.CheckObject("CLAS","ZCL_OSD_ADT_URI");issues=len(out);c.Update(original.Filename,&original.Raw)
  case "probe":
   c.Update(original.Filename,&broken);parts=append(parts,float64(time.Since(start).Nanoseconds())/1e6);now:=time.Now()
   c.Files("CLAS","MISSING");parts=append(parts,float64(time.Since(now).Nanoseconds())/1e6);now=time.Now()
   out,_:=c.CheckObject("CLAS","ZCL_OSD_ADT_URI");issues=len(out);parts=append(parts,float64(time.Since(now).Nanoseconds())/1e6);now=time.Now()
   c.Update(original.Filename,&original.Raw);parts=append(parts,float64(time.Since(now).Nanoseconds())/1e6)
  case "clean":out,_:=c.CheckObject("CLAS","ZCL_OSD_ADT_URI");issues=len(out)
  case "tree":c.Tree("CLAS","ZCL_OSD_ADT_URI")
  case "snapshot":var snapshot lint.Checker;snapshot.Prime(files,nil,data.Config);snapshot.Tree("CLAS","ZCL_OSD_ADT_URI")
  case "outline":outline(files,data.Config)
  default:panic(command)
  }
  elapsed:=time.Since(start);runtime.ReadMemStats(&mem1);after:=c.Stats()
  value:=struct{Command string;Milliseconds float64;Parts []float64;Issues int;Stats lint.Stats;AllocBytes,Mallocs,GCPauseNS uint64;GCs uint32}{command,float64(elapsed.Nanoseconds())/1e6,parts,issues,lint.Stats{Updates:after.Updates-before.Updates,Noops:after.Noops-before.Noops,IndexedObjects:after.IndexedObjects-before.IndexedObjects,ReaderVisits:after.ReaderVisits-before.ReaderVisits,DirtiedObjects:after.DirtiedObjects-before.DirtiedObjects,ParseRuns:after.ParseRuns-before.ParseRuns,ParseObjects:after.ParseObjects-before.ParseObjects},mem1.TotalAlloc-mem0.TotalAlloc,mem1.Mallocs-mem0.Mallocs,mem1.PauseTotalNs-mem0.PauseTotalNs,mem1.NumGC-mem0.NumGC}
  if err=encoder.Encode(value);err!=nil{panic(err)}
 }
}
